status: independently rebuilt; unvalidated drafts; publication deferred
scope: All active technique and subtechnique objects in the three pinned ATT&CK 19.2 domain bundles. Coverage is catalog completeness, not detection effectiveness.

methods.procedures: Active uses relationship to active same-domain technique, from active intrusion-set, malware, tool or campaign. Preserve every qualifying relation, complete description and external references.
methods.strategy: Active detects relationship from active x-mitre-detection-strategy to active technique.
methods.analytics: Resolve strategy.x_mitre_analytic_refs to active x-mitre-analytic objects. Do not infer links for unreferenced analytics.
methods.parents: Resolve active subtechnique-of relationship to active parent technique.
methods.tacticNames: Resolve source kill-chain phase_name through same-domain active x-mitre-tactic.x_mitre_shortname.
methods.absence: Missing source arrays become empty arrays. No platform, telemetry, analytic link, procedure or tuning value is inferred.
methods.examples: At most three qualifying procedure relationships per technique, sorted by relationship STIX ID.
methods.historicalIds: Historical exclusions retain legacy mitre-mobile-attack and mitre-ics-attack external-reference namespaces where present.
methods.prompts: Exactly core.composePrompt(record) with default detect mode, Platform-neutral target and empty local context.
methods.validation: Deterministic generation and exact file parity only; no model or detection execution.
